description: This file defines the 'MasterIf' class, which implements the logic for an 'if' conditional element in a mini language framework. It manages condition evaluation and execution of sub-operations based on the condition, handling 'then', 'else-if', and 'else' branches.

classes.name: MasterIf
classes.description: Implements a conditional 'if' operation with support for 'then', 'else-if', and 'else' branches in a mini language processing framework.

classes.name: MasterIf.MasterIfFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of the MasterIf operation from XML elements.

methods.name: MasterIf
methods.description: Constructor that parses the XML element representing the 'if' condition and its branches, initializing the condition and sub-operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional logic: evaluates the main condition, runs 'then' sub-operations if true, or evaluates 'else-if' conditions, or runs 'else' sub-operations as appropriate.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from all sub-operations within the 'if' structure.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the 'if' condition for debugging purposes.
